## Findings
- claim-1: \(H^*(\mathrm{Gr}_{r,n})\cong\Lambda/I_{r,q}\), \(q=n-r\), where \(I_{r,q}\) is spanned integrally by \(s_\lambda\) with \(\lambda\nsubseteq q^r\); truncated Schur multiplication is integral. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 207-218]
- claim-2: For \(v_{r,s,t,n}\), \(i=s-t+1,\ j=r-t+1\), and \(a=\min(q-i,r-j),\ b=\min(i,j)\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]
- claim-3: Partition conjugation induces an integral graded algebra isomorphism \[ \omega_{r,q}:A_{r,q}:=\Lambda/I_{r,q}\xrightarrow{\sim}A_{q,r}, \qquad \bar s_\lambda\mapsto\bar s_{\lambda'}, \] with inverse \(\omega_{q,r}\).
- claim-4: Under the Grassmannian interval presentation \[ J_v=\bigoplus_{i^j\subseteq\lambda\subseteq q^r}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda, \] one has \(\omega_{r,q}(J_v)=J_{v^\vee}\), where \[ v^\vee=v_{q,\ q+j-i,\ q-i+1,\ n}, \quad (i^\vee,j^\vee,a^\vee,b^\vee)=(j,i,a,b). \]
- claim-5: Conjugation preserves positive degree and hence descends integrally to \[ J_v/A_{r,q,+}J_v\ \xrightarrow{\sim}\ J_{v^\vee}/A_{q,r,+}J_{v^\vee}. \] It preserves every partition-weight degree, all torsion orders, and degreewise free ranks.
## Strategy
The ring-level map passes: \(\lambda\subseteq q^r\iff\lambda'\subseteq r^q\), so Schur conjugation descends integrally to \(\Lambda/I_{r,q}\cong\Lambda/I_{q,r}\), preserves weight, and is involutive.

The first unsupported premise is the general identification
\[
J_v=\bigoplus_{i^j\subseteq\lambda\subseteq q^r}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda
\]
and its identification after conjugation with \(J_{v^\vee}\). Claim-4 in the ledger is explicitly conditional on this interval presentation and remains unsupported. Audit stops here; thus descent on \(A_+J_v\), parameter translation, quotient inverse, and boundary cases cannot be certified.

## Gaps
**Required repair certificate:** a standalone integral proof, for every admissible \(v_{r,s,t,n}\), deriving the displayed Grassmannian Schur-basis interval from the one-line bigrassmannian formula and Bruhat comparison, and proving that conjugation identifies it with the corresponding interval for
\[
v^\vee=v_{q,\ q+j-i,\ q-i+1,\ n},
\]
including all degenerate cases \(a=0\), \(i=q\), \(j=r\), \(r=1\), and \(q=1\).

## Next
The requested quotient-conjugation target is **not established** by this audit. No \(G_L\)-to-\(G_R\) transition computation was run.
